Master Services Agreement — ACME Robotics Inc. & Orbital Logistics LLC

Clause 4. Term and Renewal

This Agreement commences on 1 February 2025 and continues for an initial term of thirty-six (36) months, renewing automatically for successive twelve (12) month periods unless either party gives ninety (90) days written notice of non-renewal.

Clause 9. Limitation of Liability

Except for breaches of Clause 12 (Confidentiality), each party's aggregate liability is capped at the fees paid in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim, and in no event exceeds $5,000,000.

Clause 14. Service Credits

ACME Robotics Inc. — Q3 2025 Financial Report

Management Discussion

ACME Robotics reported total revenue of $482.3 million in Q3 2025, up 18.4% year-over-year, driven primarily by the Industrial Automation segment. Gross margin expanded to 61.2% from 58.9% in Q3 2024. Operating expenses rose 11% to $186.4 million due to expanded R&D; headcount in the Autonomous Systems division. Net income was $74.1 million, or $1.32 per diluted share.

Risk Factors

The company notes continued supply-chain exposure for precision actuators sourced from two suppliers, and foreign-exchange headwinds of approximately $6.2 million in EMEA. Full-year 2025 revenue guidance is raised to $1.92–$1.96 billion.
